# X Look

> X Look is a free Chrome (MV3) extension that turns x.com into a quiet, work-friendly reading list: no left nav, no trends column, no Grok or messages drawer, no promoted posts, one calm centred column, images and videos hidden until you click them, a box that filters posts by words, and a toolbar icon that switches it off and on. It collects nothing and sends nothing anywhere ([privacy](https://xlook.cocode.dk/#privacy)).

This site has WebMCP tools. Both pages register them with `document.modelContext.registerTool`, so an agent in the visitor's browser can call them instead of scraping the page. All four are read-only, take no input, and answer in the page's own language.

## Pages that declare WebMCP tools

- [English](https://xlook.cocode.dk/): declares `describe`, `list_features`, `get_install_steps`, `get_privacy`
- [فارسی (Persian)](https://xlook.cocode.dk/fa/): declares the same four tools, answering in Persian

## Tools

- `describe`: says what the page is; returns `{ language, title, summary, download_url, sections: [{ id, heading }], tools: [string] }`
- `list_features`: lists every change X Look makes to x.com; returns `{ language, features: [{ name, detail }] }`
- `get_install_steps`: the ordered install steps and the download link; returns `{ language, download_url, steps: [string] }`. It installs nothing.
- `get_privacy`: what X Look and this site do and do not do with your data; returns `{ language, summary, points: [string] }`

The tools work in Chrome with WebMCP switched on (`chrome://flags/#enable-webmcp-testing`); elsewhere the pages read as plain HTML.

## Links

- [Download x-look.zip](https://github.com/cocodedk/x-look/releases/latest/download/x-look.zip): the latest release
- [Source](https://github.com/cocodedk/x-look): code, issues, README
